name: Plum extract
description: Plum extract ( CAS 90082-87-4 ), also supplied as Prunus Domestica Extract, is derived from the fruit and seeds of the common plum and delivers concentrated flavor, color, and antioxidant activity to finished formulations. It functions as both a natural flavoring agent and a stabilizing antioxidant across food, cosmetic, and nutraceutical applications. In food and beverage manufacturing, it provides authentic plum flavor and natural color. This extract is ideal for confectionery, bakery fillings, sauces, and functional beverages. Nutraceutical formulators incorporate it into dietary supplements and health-oriented products where polyphenol-rich botanical extracts are required. In personal care, it is used in skin care formulations such as serums, creams, and hair treatments. Fruit-derived antioxidants support product stability and ingredient positioning in high-end cosmetic lines. Pharmaceutical and healthcare product developers also source it for standardized botanical preparations targeting antioxidant activity. Plum extract is available as a liquid extract, spray-dried powder, and seed oil fraction. Standard grades include food-grade and cosmetic-grade specifications for various industrial needs. Some suppliers offer standardized extracts defined by polyphenol or anthocyanin content to meet specific formulation goals. Buyers should confirm solvent system, carrier, and standardization parameters when evaluating grades across suppliers.
